Select drug-indication relationships for approved drugs. Join drug_indication with molecule_dictionary on molregno to obtain chembl_id and pref_name. Return mesh_id, mesh_heading, efo_id as indication_curie, efo_term as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, mesh_id, mesh_heading, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
